data.strFullDescription: [p]Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.[/p][p align="center"][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/1f275104b9d7c3ca0a69c90233c45522.poster.avif?t=1777505458" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/1f275104b9d7c3ca0a69c90233c45522.webm?t=1777505458" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][p]Welcome aboard, roving voyager.[/p][p]Upon the shores lay the silent embers of a world during the Ebb Tide.[/p][p]Desolated by the Lament, the erstwhile creations and earthly beings are left static.[/p][p]But they strike back, strong enough to penetrate the silence.[/p][p]Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse.[/p][p]And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening.[/p][p]Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future.[/p][p]As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey.[/p][p]Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover.[/p][h2]Delve into an expansive world / Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew[/h2][p]Embrace high degrees of freedom in immersive overworld explorations. Free yourself from stamina limits, dash and parkour on walls, take Flight, and ride a high-mobility expedition motorbike to enjoy open-world exploration. As the world of Solaris-3 unfolds, your lost memory begins to see its recovery through this ceaseless quest.[/p][p align="center"][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/8aebe1467b983399f3e6e339227a62fd.poster.avif?t=1777505458" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/8aebe1467b983399f3e6e339227a62fd.webm?t=1777505458" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/8aebe1467b983399f3e6e339227a62fd.webp?t=1777505458" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Enjoy extreme battle experience / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat [/h2][p]Avail against enemy attacks in smooth and fast-paced combat. Apply easy controls of Extreme Evasion, Dodge Counter, Echo Skill, and unique QTE mechanisms that allow the fullest possibility of battle experience.[/p][p align="center"][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/41c4b38f400bd867a8cafa19e85d9af2.poster.avif?t=1777505458" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/41c4b38f400bd867a8cafa19e85d9af2.webm?t=1777505458" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/41c4b38f400bd867a8cafa19e85d9af2.webp?t=1777505458" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Immerse in breathtaking storytelling / Witness a delicate fusion of story, sound, and vision[/h2][p]With cinematic narratives, rich music, and stunning animation, Solaris delivers a high-quality sensory journey that brings every story to life.[/p][p align="center"][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/64cf0c73042cdeb4bb3cde7ed16ea8e0.poster.avif?t=1777505458" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/64cf0c73042cdeb4bb3cde7ed16ea8e0.webm?t=1777505458" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/64cf0c73042cdeb4bb3cde7ed16ea8e0.webp?t=1777505458" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Encounter Resonators / Forte awakened, journey alongside your companions [/h2][p]Compose a harmonious battle concerto with Resonators of different abilities. Their unique Fortes revealing distinctive personalities will be your strong assets for the journey ahead.[/p][p align="center"][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/73aa9fdd79086c3d2ce96abf516d025e.poster.avif?t=1777505458" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3513350/extras/73aa9fdd79086c3d2ce96abf516d025e.webm?t=1777505458" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p]
